whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Dental Clinic,

I noticed your dental clinic has a stellar 5.0★ rating in Patna, but your online presence redirects to a generic third-party marketplace instead of a dedicated professional website.

Maine aapke clinic ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp appointment booking, dental treatments showcase, aur clinic timings integrate ki hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/dental

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Dental Clinic team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke clinic (Dental Clinic on Exhibition Road, Patna) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp booking, mobile-first speed, and a showcase of your dental care services right here in Patna. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact services, actual clinic photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
